claims.statement: Post-authorization argument mutation is rejected on the protected path with stable reason code execution.arguments_digest_mismatch.
claims.confidence: high for reference kernel; medium for core baseline
claims.scope: Protected execution path; refund mutation demonstration; historical core baseline and reference kernel.
claims.falsification_condition: A mutated live intent reaches protected dispatch or is accepted without an arguments-digest mismatch.
limitations: No live payment processor is contacted.
Reference kernel uses illustrative HMAC and in-memory replay store.
claims.next_validation_step: Independent operator runs the core demo under a recorded environment.

claims.statement: A decision receipt consumed by protected execution cannot be reused within the active consumption boundary.
claims.confidence: high for in-memory kernel; medium for core SQLite path
claims.scope: Single-host consumption boundary (durable SQLite consumption boundary in core; volatile in-memory replay store in reference kernel).
claims.falsification_condition: A second use of the same consumed receipt reaches the executor.
limitations: Reference kernel store is a volatile in-memory set wiped upon process restart, not durable storage.
claims.next_validation_step: Crash-recovery test of the core consumption store.

claims.statement: MCP posture auditing fails closed when supplied configuration contains a direct or parallel unmediated route.
claims.scope: Supplied MCP client configuration analyzed by mcp-posture.
claims.falsification_condition: A known direct/parallel route is classified as protected or exits successfully under fail-on-bypass.
claims.next_validation_step: Publish a redacted configuration fixture for community reproduction.

claims.statement: Ambiguous external effects are modeled as UNKNOWN and require reconciliation before retry by default in historical core architecture.
claims.scope: Historical core baseline architecture pinned to source snapshot 8c3c69ea12e434e2223b7452654c23dece858d34.
claims.reproduction: architecture review + core tests at historical snapshot
claims.falsification_condition: Default path retries an UNKNOWN effect without reconciliation.
limitations: Tied strictly to historical core snapshot 8c3c69ea12e434e2223b7452654c23dece858d34; does not validate current core main.

Subsequent core revisions (Q04-01 through Q04-05) introduced critical reconciliation and admission hardening (lock-safe dispatch admission, recovery containment, terminal exclusion, worker progress fairness, separate provider hashing) which are NOT validated by this historical evidence package.
Not demonstrated in the public reference kernel.
claims.next_validation_step: Add an UNKNOWN/reconciliation fixture to the public reference kernel.

limitations: Does not prove AgentGuard core behavior.
